title: Reference approach: End-to-End Numerical Data Analysis Platform
approach: Validate external input shape, dtype, and fields before numerical work.
Use ndarray operations and choose explicit axes and tolerance rules.
Separate loading, transformation, analysis, and reporting into testable functions.
Use synthetic fixtures and test invalid/boundary cases.
Record assumptions, environment versions, and performance measurements.
acceptance_guidance: Load CSV and NumPy binary inputs.
Validate dimensions, dtype, expected fields, and non-finite values.
Filter, transform, sort, and normalize under documented rules.
Calculate statistics, percentiles, correlations, and one numerical/linear-algebra result.
Export processed arrays and a summary report.
Test typical, boundary, and invalid cases; record limitations and versions.
explanation: Create a reusable numerical analysis workflow that imports raw data, validates it, analyzes arrays, and exports reproducible results. This is a reference approach, not a complete executable deliverable. Final reference code and tests require technical review before release.
